finalText:
All application code is migrated. Only `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js` still uses `db.query`, and that file is explicitly marked as a vendored third-party copy that must not be edited (overwritten on every upgrade), so it's correctly left as-is — `db.js` keeps the deprecated `query` method around for that reason.

**Migrated (12 files):** `packages/support/{admin/macroAdmin.js, repo/sla.js}`, `packages/orders/{service/returnService.js, repo/shipment.js}`, `packages/accounts/{service/teamService.js, admin/apiKeyAdmin.js, repo/session.js}`, `packages/billing/{service/couponService.js, repo/refund.js}`, `packages/analytics/repo/cohort.js`, `packages/catalog/{repo/supplier.js, admin/variantAdmin.js}` — all `db.query(sql, params)` calls converted to `db.execute({ sql, params })`.

**Left alone:** `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js` (vendored, do-not-edit) and `cache.query` calls (unrelated cache API, not the db client).
